title: mrp_workorder — Detailed Workorders
findings: Standalone mrp_workorder addon is absent; Community 19 bundles the mrp.workorder model inside the mrp addon
The mrp addon manifest (LGPL-3) has no dependency on a separate mrp_workorder package
State machine has 5 states: blocked/ready/progress/done/cancel; default is ready
Time tracking uses mrp.workcenter.productivity One2many; button_start opens a timer, button_finish/end_all closes it
Productivity records classified as productive (duration <= expected) or performance loss (overrun)
MO _compute_state transitions to to_close only when ALL workorders are done or cancel
BOM operations drive workorder creation via _compute_workorder_ids() during draft state
_link_workorders_and_moves() builds sequential chain or dependency graph from operation blocked_by links
_plan_workorder() picks the earliest-available workcenter slot considering alternatives
No quality_control integration found in Community mrp; quality steps are an Enterprise mrp_workorder feature
qty_ready propagates progressively through dependency chain enabling flow production
